reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0058 (fixed per-US$1m fee tiers) and p0078 (flat 33% revenue share on defined usage categories) are fixed-consideration/revenue-share terms with no benchmarking to terms granted to third parties, so no parity obligation runs against Licensee.

The only 'other licensees' reference (p0094, Revisions made available when generally released to other licensees) benefits the Customer, which the rule expressly treats as compliant and not to be redlined.
Consistent with the rule's redline guidance, no edit or counterparty comment is proposed; the rendered redline is unchanged from the originals and no deterministic check failures were raised.

The rationale correctly scopes out the Right of First Refusal and change-of-control consent as assignment/M&A controls rather than best-terms parity, so they belong to other playbook rules and do not undermine the MFN compliance call.
